[[File:Olomouc (031).jpg|upright=1.3|thumb|The High Public Prosecutor's Office in Olomouc oversees the investigation into the case.]]

'''Investigation of 2025 Czech government Bitcoin scandal''' comprises a series of [[politics|political]], [[law|legal]], and [[Mass media|media]] events following the replacement of [[Pavel Blažek]] by [[Eva Decroix]] as Minister of Justice in June 2025. This personnel change was precipitated by the outbreak of the so-called [[2025 Czech government Bitcoin scandal|Bitcoin scandal]].{{Refn|group=nb|The case concerns a donation in Bitcoin valued at approximately one billion CZK, accepted in March 2025 by the Ministry of Justice under Minister Pavel Blažek ([[Civic Democratic Party (Czech Republic)|ODS]]) from convicted drug trafficker {{ill|Tomáš Jiřikovský|cs}}.}}

A central component of the inquiry involved determining the whereabouts of the donor, Jiřikovský, who had fled the [[Czech Republic]]. While journalist {{ill|Zdislava Pokorná|cs}} identified the Philippines as his place of residence, officers from the Security Information Service (BIS) later established that Jiřikovský was residing in [[Taiwan]]. During his stay abroad, the {{ill|Czech Bar Association|cs|Česká advokátní komora}} initiated an investigation into Jiřikovský's legal counsel, Kárim Titz, to determine whether he had violated Act No. 253/2008 Coll. (the Anti-Money Laundering Act) while representing his client during the transfer of the gift. The investigation was overseen by the High Public Prosecutor's Office in Olomouc and a parliamentary commission tasked with monitoring the activities of the {{ill|Financial Analytical Office|cs|Finanční analytický úřad}} (FAÚ).

Upon taking office, Decroix established four mechanisms designed to clarify the events preceding the acceptance of the donation. The first element was [[timeline]], which underwent two rounds of updates in an anonymized format. As a second oversight measure, Decroix appointed attorney {{ill|David Uhlíř|cs}} as the "Bitcoin Case Coordinator." Uhlíř's mandate was to ascertain whether all internal ministerial regulations had been observed prior to the gift's acceptance. This role was functionally linked to the third measure: an audit report. The audit focused on potential legislative amendments regarding future cryptocurrency donations to the state and evaluated whether the participants in the transfer could have reasonably suspected the illicit origin of the coins. The fourth mechanism involved the engagement of the [[Supreme Audit Office (Czech Republic)|Supreme Audit Office]] (NKÚ), which Decroix approached in July 2025.

The transparency mechanisms introduced by Decroix faced widespread criticism. [[Journalism|Journalists]], [[Lawyer|legal experts]], opposition [[politician]]s, [[law enforcement agencies]], and the general public all characterized the minister's approach as detrimental. Primary concerns included the high financial costs of a parallel ministerial inquiry, the potential for public proceedings to compromise the legally binding criminal investigation,{{Refn|group=nb|By law, legally binding investigations are conducted exclusively by law enforcement agencies.}} and Decroix's perceived [[Civic Democratic Party (Czech Republic)|partisan bias]] in managing the ministry's internal probe.

Media coverage focused on both the official criminal proceedings and the ministry's internal inquiry. Reports highlighted a lack of transparency in Decroix's communication regarding the chosen oversight mechanisms, noting that their objectives shifted over time and failed to achieve their original purpose. This failure, combined with potential overreach of authority and inconsistent communication, triggered backlash from the political opposition and law enforcement. The media also pointed to unresolved personnel issues that the oversight mechanisms failed to address. Furthermore, reports surfaced regarding ineffective [[communication]] between criminal investigators and those conducting the ministerial probe. The resulting "noise" and procedural friction eventually led the Prosecutor General, [[Lenka Bradáčová]], to exercise supervisory [[jurisdiction]] over the High Public Prosecutor's Office in Olomouc.

According to High Public Prosecutor {{ill|Radim Dragoun|cs}}, the scope of potential legal violations expanded following Jiřikovský's apprehension in August 2025. This expansion of legal liability was further underscored by Decroix's public remarks, in which she characterized court rulings regarding the return of seized [[electronics]] as unlawful. However, the broadening of the case to include other stakeholders was constrained by the head of the [[Security Information Service|BIS]], Michal Koudelka, who stated that the case was not instigated by foreign power.

== Stay in Taiwan ==
On 5 June 2025, the news outlet ''Neovlivni.cz'' reported that Jiřikovský had departed for Asia. His travel was legally permissible at the time as no formal charges had been brought against him.<ref>{{cite web| last = Slonková
| first = Sabina| title = Hlavní aktér bitcoinové aféry zmizel. Je v Asii | trans-title =The main protagonist of the Bitcoin affair has disappeared. He is in Asia | website = Neovlivni.cz| url = https://neovlivni.cz/hlavni-akter-bitcoinove-afery-zmizel-je-v-asii/| date = 2025-06-05| access-date = 2025-06-12| language = cs}}</ref> It was subsequently established that he was staying in [[Taiwan]] with his [[Filipinos|Filipino]] wife;<ref>{{cite web|last=Kozelka|first=Petr| title = Advokát z bitcoinové kauzy promluvil: Žádné pokání. Miliardový dar si chtěl klient odečíst z daní | trans-title =Lawyer from the Bitcoin case speaks out: No repentance. The client wanted to deduct the billion-dollar gift from taxes| website =[[Novinky.cz]]| url = https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/krimi-advokat-z-bitcoinove-kauzy-promluvil-zadne-pokani-miliardovy-dar-si-chtel-klient-odecist-z-dani-40525365| date = 2025-06-14| language = cs| access-date = 2025-06-14|publisher=Borgis}}</ref> he was reportedly scheduled to return to the Czech Republic in the latter half of June.<ref>{{cite web| last = Blažek| first = Vojtěch| title = Blažkova dárce dosledovali na Tchaj-wanu. Prý však přijede do Česka | trans-title =Blažek's donor tracked to Taiwan. However, he is reportedly coming to the Czech Republic| website = [[Seznam Zprávy]]| url = https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-blazkova-darce-dosledovali-na-tchaj-wanu-pry-vsak-prijede-do-ceska-279038| date = 2025-06-16| language = cs| access-date = 2025-06-16}}</ref>

The Czech Bar Association (ČAK) initiated an inquiry into whether Kárim Titz, the attorney representing Jiřikovský, violated [[anti-money laundering]] (AML) regulations. Under the Czech AML Act, legal counsel is required to verify the provenance of assets during suspicious transactions.<ref>{{cite web| title = Komora prověří advokáta Titze z bitcoinové kauzy | trans-title =The Bar Association will investigate attorney Titz from the Bitcoin case| website = Echo24.cz| url = https://www.echo24.cz/a/Hbs94/zpravy-domov-komora-bude-zkoumat-postup-advokata-v-bitcoinove-kauze| date = 2025-06-06| language = cs| access-date = 2025-06-18|publisher=Echo Media|agency=[[Czech News Agency]]}}</ref> The relevant legislation, Act No. 253/2008 Coll., on Certain Measures against the Legalization of Proceeds from Crime and Financing of Terrorism, governs the operations of the [[Financial Analytical Office]] (FAÚ). It defines the "obligated person" subject to reporting requirements, a category that includes practicing attorneys.<ref>{{cite web| title = Právní předpisy | trans-title =Legal Regulations| website = FAÚ| url = https://fau.gov.cz/pravni-predpisy| language = cs| access-date =2025-06-18}}</ref>

== Prosecutorial oversight and investigation ==
The case is being overseen by the High Public Prosecutor's Office in Olomouc, which has identified potential criminal activity involving the abuse of power by a public official, the laundering of proceeds of crime, and the illicit [[Manufacturing|manufacture]] and [[Smuggling|trafficking]] of [[narcotic]] and [[Psychoactive drug|psychotropic substances]].<ref name=":1">{{cite news| last = Blažek| first = Vojtěch
| title = Smlouvu s Blažkem přinesl Jiřikovský i do směnárny. Doufal, že mu pomůže| trans-title = Jiřikovský also brought the contract with Blažek to the exchange office. He hoped it would help him| url = https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-smlouvu-s-blazkem-prinesl-jirikovsky-i-do-smenarny-doufal-ze-mu-pomuze-278868| work = [[Seznam Zprávy]]| date = 2025-06-12| access-date = 2025-06-12| language = cs}}</ref> Officers from the [[National Organized Crime Agency]] (NCOZ) have requested the cooperation of the American [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] to jointly investigate Jiřikovský's alleged links to the [[Dark web|darknet]] marketplace Nucleus Market.<ref name=":11a">{{cite news| last = Pokorná| first = Zdislava| title = Do bitcoinové kauzy se vloží FBI. Policie prověřuje, zda dárce stál i za dalším drogovým tržištěm| trans-title = FBI to intervene in Bitcoin case. Police investigate whether donor was behind another drug marketplace| work = Deník N| url = https://denikn.cz/1748336/do-bitcoinove-kauzy-se-vlozila-fbi-policie-proveruje-zda-darce-stal-i-za-dalsim-drogovym-trzistem/| date = 2025-06-02| language = cs
| access-date = 2025-06-10}}</ref> On 11 June 2025, members of the parliamentary committee overseeing the Financial Analytical Office (FAÚ) deliberated on the matter and concluded that the office had acted correctly and in accordance with the law.<ref name=":1" />

== No foreign involvement in case, according to BIS ==
During a meeting of the Chamber of Deputies' Committee on Security on 12 June 2025, Michal Koudelka, the Director of the Security Information Service (BIS), assured MPs that the case had not been initiated or orchestrated by foreign powers.{{citation needed|date=March 2026}} On the same day, detectives from the National Centre for Combating Organised Crime (NCOZ) seized documents related to the "Bitcoin case" at the Ministries of Justice and Finance. The newly appointed Minister of Justice, Eva Decroix (ODS), expressed her full cooperation with the investigation and announced plans to present [[timeline]] of events to the government within a week.<ref>{{cite news |last=Jelínková |first=Kristýna |title=NCOZ si z ministerstev odnesla dokumenty k bitcoinové kauze |trans-title=NCOZ seized documents related to Bitcoin case from ministries |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/ncoz-si-z-ministerstev-odnesla-dokumenty-k-bitcoinove-kauze-361930 |work=ČT24 |publisher=Czech Television |date=2025-06-12 |access-date=2025-06-12 |language=cs}}</ref> [[Pavel Žáček]] (ODS), Chairman of the Committee on Security, stated that investigators would need to engage in international cooperation.<ref>{{cite news |title=Detektivové si přišli na ministerstva pro dokumenty k bitcoinové kauze |trans-title=Detectives arrive at ministries for documents regarding Bitcoin case |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-politika-detektivove-si-prisli-na-ministerstva-pro-dokumenty-k-bitcoinove-kauze-278979 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-06-12 |access-date=2025-06-12 |language=cs}}</ref>

== Ministry negotiations with coin buyers and Decroix’s legality challenge ==
On 17 June 2025, the newly appointed Minister of Justice, Eva Decroix, announced that the Ministry of Justice had liquidated a majority (235) of the 468 donated bitcoins, while expressing an intent to cancel a portion of remaining [[Financial transaction|transaction]]s. The Ministry stated it is in [[communication]] with the buyers and has initiated [[negotiation]]s with the law firm representing the primary [[Purchasing|purchaser]] (see legal representative Kirill Juran).<ref>{{cite news |title=Z bitcoinů prodalo ministerstvo polovinu, část dalších transakcí chce stornovat |work=Seznam Zprávy |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-politika-z-bitcoinu-prodalo-ministerstvo-polovinu-cast-dalsich-transakci-chce-stornovat-279369 |date=2025-06-17 |language=cs |access-date=2025-06-17}}</ref>

Simultaneously, the Minister disclosed that she is finalizing a "complaint for violation of the law" (in Czech "stížnost pro porušení zákona") regarding the [[Regional Court in Brno]]'s decision to return seized electronics to Jiřikovský. Decroix asserted that the court's ruling may have been unlawful, alleging a failure to respect the binding legal opinion of the Supreme Court. However, she noted that the contested decision is now irreversible.<ref>{{cite news |title=Decroix podala v bitcoinové kauze stížnost pro porušení zákona |work=ČT24 |publisher=Czech Television |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci-decroix-k-dalsim-krokum-v-bitcoinove-kauze-362051 |date=2025-06-17 |language=cs |access-date=2025-06-17}}</ref>

== Deputy Přibyl's non-participation in the donation acceptance ==
Daniel Přibyl, a deputy at the Office for Government Representation in Property Affairs ({{ill|ÚZSVM|cs|Úřad pro zastupování státu ve věcech majetkových}}), received a formal disciplinary warning regarding his attempt to participate in the opening of [[Cryptocurrency wallet|Bitcoin wallet]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Pšenička |first=Jiří |trans-title=Deputy Property Office Director Receives Warning of Dismissal Over Bitcoin|title=Náměstek majetkového úřadu dostal kvůli bitcoinům výstrahu před výpovědí |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-namestek-majetkoveho-uradu-dostal-kvuli-bitcoinum-vystrahu-pred-vypovedi-279386 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-06-17 |language=cs |access-date=2025-06-17}}</ref> Ultimately, Přibyl faced only indirect financial [[Sanctions (law)|sanctions]]; he was denied [[Bonus payment|personal bonuses]] for the second quarter of 2025, which for his colleagues ranged between 46,000 and 126,000 CZK.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Pšenička |first=Jiří|trans-title= The head of the office wanted to fire the deputy for bitcoins, but in the end she just took his bonuses|title=Šéfka úřadu chtěla vyhodit náměstka za bitcoiny, nakonec mu jen vzala odměny |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-trest-za-bitcoiny-namestek-z-majetkoveho-uradu-prisel-o-premie-284903 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-08-30 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-30}}</ref> The Director General of the ÚZSVM, Kateřina Arajmu, confirmed that the office’s role was limited to providing a Bitcoin wallet for the transfer of the donation.<ref name=":33">{{Cite news |last=Müller |first=Matyáš |trans-title= Deputy threatened to be fired over bitcoin scandal. In the end, he just lost his bonuses|title=Náměstkovi hrozil kvůli bitcoinové kauze vyhazov. Nakonec jen přišel o odměny |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/bitcoin-afera-uzsvm-pribyl-namestek.A250830_083712_domaci_mul |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-08-30 |access-date=2025-08-31|publisher=Mafra|language=cs}}</ref> Despite being mentioned twice in the initial version of the event timeline, Arajmu stated that Přibyl did not act outside the scope of his official authority.<ref name=":33" />

And since no one is asking this fundamental question (yes, it is more media-friendly to "chasing" Stanjur, who, unlike the police, could not have known about any illegal marketplace), I take the liberty of presenting it to the public.| url = https://x.com/blazek_p/status/1958529901197140211| publisher = X (formerly Twitter)| date = 2025-08-21| access-date = 2026-01-29| language = cs}}</ref>}}

== Audit as part of the investigation ==
Decroix clarified that if no private firm applied to conduct the audit, a form of internal audit would be necessary.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kroc|first1=Vladimír|last2=Beneda|first2=Josef|title=Kdy se měly rozsvítit červené kontrolky? Byrokratický postup s bitcoiny byl velmi zlehčený, říká Decroix |trans-title=When should the red lights have flashed? The bureaucratic process with bitcoins was greatly downplayed, says Decroix |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/kdy-se-mely-rozsvitit-cervene-kontrolky-byrokraticky-postup-s-bitcoiny-byl-velmi_2506242048_job |work=iROZHLAS.cz |publisher=Czech Radio |date=2025-06-24 |language=cs |access-date=2025-06-24}}</ref> Ultimately, no private entities officially applied for the tender.<ref>{{cite news |last=Soukup|first=Jaroslav|title=Ministerstvo spravedlnosti nenašlo auditora pro bitcoinovou kauzu |trans-title=Ministry of Justice failed to find an auditor for the bitcoin case |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-nenaslo-auditora-na-bitcoinovou-kauzu-40527514 |work=Novinky.cz |date=2025-06-25 |language=cs |access-date=2025-06-27|publisher=Borgis|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref> In July 2025, Decroix secured an auditor for the case: a consortium comprising the firms ''Grant Thornton Czech Republic'' and ''Grant Thornton Audit''. The Czech state, via taxpayer funds, paid 3.57 million CZK (including VAT) for the service.<ref>{{cite news |title=Externí audit v bitcoinové kauze provede sdružení firem Grant Thornton |trans-title=External audit in the bitcoin case to be conducted by Grant Thornton consortium |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-externi-audit-v-bitcoinove-kauze-provede-firma-grant-thornton-281526 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-07-09 |language=cs |access-date=2025-07-11|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref>

The auditors concluded that the Ministry of Justice should not have accepted the Bitcoin donation, as it was aware beforehand that the assets might have originated from criminal proceeds.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ministerstvo spravedlnosti nemělo přijímat bitcoinový dar, vyplývá z auditu|trans-title=Ministry of Justice should not have accepted the bitcoin donation, audit finds |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-nemelo-prijimat-bitcoinovy-dar-vyplyva-z-auditu-40532601 |work=Novinky.cz |date=2025-07-31 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-01|publisher=Borgis|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref> In their external report, the auditors criticized the ministry for failing to take necessary steps to rule out the illegality of the donated funds.<ref>{{cite news |title=Audit v kauze bitcoinů: Ministerstvo spravedlnosti nenaplnilo princip řádné správy a odpovědného výkonu veřejné moci |trans-title=Audit in the bitcoin case: Ministry of Justice failed to fulfill principles of good governance and responsible public administration |url=https://denikn.cz/minuta/1799684/ |work=Deník N |date=2025-07-31 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-01|publisher=N media}}</ref> The report stated: "There is a risk that the acceptance of the donation, its subsequent handling, and its eventual sale through public [[Auction|auction]] may have fulfilled the elements of certain [[Criminal law|criminal offenses]]."<ref>{{cite news |title=Ministerstvo spravedlnosti nemělo přijímat bitcoinový dar, zjistil audit |trans-title=Ministry of Justice should not have accepted the bitcoin donation, audit found |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-nemelo-prijimat-bitcoinovy-dar-zjistil-audit-282994 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-07-31 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-01|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref>

Following a meeting of the [[Mayors and Independents|STAN]] leadership, Decroix—who attended the session—was given an ultimatum to release the full audit by the end of August 2025.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gričová|first1=Andrea|last2=Hosenseidlová|first2=Petra|agency=Czech News Agency |title=STAN požaduje, aby ministerstvo spravedlnosti zveřejnilo do konce srpna audit k bitcoinové kauze |trans-title=STAN demands Ministry of Justice release bitcoin case audit by end of August |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci-stan-chce-objasneni-bitcoinove-kauzy-jinak-hrozi-i-odchod-z-vlady-rekl-farsky-363753 |work=ČT24 |publisher=Czech Television |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-07}}</ref> Decroix convened a press conference on Friday, 8 August 2025, to clarify the role of Uhlíř at the ministry.<ref>{{cite news |first=Eliška |last=Hovorková |title=Decroix na popud STAN zase vysvětlovala bitcoiny. Rakušana nepřesvědčila |trans-title=At STAN's prompting, Decroix explained the bitcoins again. She did not convince Rakušan |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/decroix-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-bitcoiny-koordinator-uhlir.A250808_122643_domaci_hovo |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-08-08 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-08|publisher=Mafra}}</ref> After the conference, during which Decroix stated she had no new information to share, STAN chairman [[Vít Rakušan]] set a condition for any future coalition between STAN and [[Spolu]]: that the Ministry of Justice must be led by a minister from the Mayors and Independents.<ref>{{cite news |last=Horák|first=Viktor|title=Rakušan kriticky k Decroix. „Spravedlnost povedou Starostové. Je potřeba být otevřenější“|trans-title=Rakušan critical of Decroix: "Justice will be led by the Mayors. More openness is needed" |url=https://www.echo24.cz/a/HC8Jg/zpravy-domov-rakusan-se-pustil-do-decroix-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-budou-vest-starostove |work=Echo24.cz |date=2025-08-08 |language=cs |access-date=2025-08-08|publisher=Echo Media}}</ref>

The second part of the audit summary revealed that the state should amend laws to better define "at-risk assets" and regulate the legislative process for accepting cryptocurrencies as donations.<ref name=":34">{{cite news |agency=Czech News Agency |title=Předpisy by měly definovat rizikový majetek, uvedl audit k bitcoinové kauze |trans-title=Regulations should define at-risk assets, states bitcoin case audit |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/kauza-bitcoin-audit-stat-priprava-nabyvani-digitalnich-aktiv.A250831_223304_domaci_ikul |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-08-31 |language=cs |access-date=2025-09-01|publisher=Mafra}}</ref> This summary also confirmed that [[Pavel Blažek|Blažek]] proceeded with cryptocurrency auctions despite being aware of their origins.<ref name=":3a">{{cite news |title=Za přijetí bitcoinového daru nese odpovědnost Blažkův náměstek, uvedl audit|trans-title=Blažek's deputy bears responsibility for accepting bitcoin donation, audit says |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-stat-by-se-mel-pripravit-na-nabyvani-digitalnich-aktiv-doporucil-audit-285033 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-08-31 |language=cs |access-date=2025-09-01|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref>

Although STAN cabinet members demanded the public release of the full report, Decroix had not published the complete contents by 1 September 2025.<ref name=":34" /> Chief Prosecutor Dragoun requested that Decroix refrain from releasing the full text at that time, arguing that publication could compromise ongoing witness testimony.<ref name=":4a">{{cite news |title=Žalobci žádají,aby zpráva z auditu k bitcoinové kauze teď plně zveřejněna nebyla |trans-title=Prosecutors request that the bitcoin case audit report not be fully published now |url=https://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/2716216 |work=ČeskéNoviny.cz |publisher=Czech News Agency |language=cs |access-date=2025-09-03}}</ref> The failure to publish the audit constituted a breach of the condition set by STAN leadership in early August 2025.<ref name=":5a">{{cite news |title=Zveřejněte audit k bitcoinové kauze, vyzvalo hnutí STAN Decroix. Má i termín |trans-title=Release the bitcoin case audit, STAN movement urges Decroix. A deadline has been set |url=https://zpravy.aktualne.cz/domaci/stan-decroix/r~7f92203c72e611f095ee0cc47ab5f122/ |work=Aktuálně.cz |date=2025-08-06 |language=cs |access-date=2025-09-03|publisher=Economia|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref>

== Investigation by the coordinator and its abrupt conclusion ==
[[File:David uhlíř.jpg|thumb|upright|David Uhlíř, who was appointed as the "BTC Case Coordinator" but resigned midway through his term. In a departure from the original contract, he received a partial remuneration of 160,000 CZK.]]

In June 2025, an internal investigation into the case at the Ministry of Justice was led by a "BTC Case Coordinator." {{ill|David Uhlíř|cs}}, a lawyer, was appointed to this role by Eva Decroix.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Koordinátorem objasňování bitcoinové kauzy je Uhlíř, seznámí se s časovou osou|trans-title=Uhlíř is the coordinator for clarifying the Bitcoin case, will familiarize himself with the timeline |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-zivot-v-cesku-koordinatorem-objasnovani-bitcoinove-kauzy-je-uhlir-seznami-se-s-casovou-osou-279647 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-06-19 |access-date=2025-07-03 |language=cs|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref> Uhlíř's original remuneration was set at 320,000 CZK for the period from his appointment until October 2025.<ref name=":13">{{Cite web |last=Paseková |first=Eva |title=Bitcoinová kauza: Koordinátor Uhlíř dostane za vyšetřování 320 tisíc|trans-title=Bitcoin Case: Coordinator Uhlíř to receive 320,000 for the investigation |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2025/06/bitcoinova-kauza-koordinator-uhlir-dostane-za-vysetrovani-320-tisic/ |work=Česká justice |date=2025-06-27 |access-date=2025-07-03 |language=cs}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Zpráva, která měla být, nebude. Bitcoiny si ministerstvo brát nemělo, řekl koordinátor Uhlíř|trans-title=The report that was supposed to be, won't be. The ministry should not have taken the Bitcoins, says coordinator Uhlíř |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-zprava-ktera-mela-byt-nebude-koordinator-uhlir-k-ni-nevidi-duvod-40533062 |work=[[Novinky.cz]]|date=2025-08-05 |access-date=2025-08-05 |language=cs|publisher=Borgis}}</ref> Decroix described Uhlíř as: "a person who (...) is there also for opposition representatives and others who might feel that an ODS minister is sweeping something under the rug."<ref name=":15" /> In addition to Uhlíř, Decroix retained three other law firms in connection with the Bitcoin case. The first two firms are to receive 600,000 CZK from the ministry, including [[Value-added tax|VAT]], while the third firm has an hourly rate set at 5,600 CZK.<ref name=":13" />

In a July 2025 interview with ''Seznam Zprávy'', Uhlíř admitted that he did not understand Bitcoin or its underlying technology at all.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hovorková |first=Eliška |title=Kryptoměnám nerozumím, přiznal koordinátor bitcoinové aféry|trans-title=I don't understand cryptocurrencies, admitted the Bitcoin affair coordinator |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/david-uhlir-bitcoinova-kauza-kryptomena-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti.A250709_130916_domaci_hovo |work=[[iDNES.cz]] |publisher=[[Mafra (company)|Mafra]] |date=2025-07-09 |access-date=2025-07-09 |language=cs}}</ref> He further criticized the technology itself due to the production of [[Greenhouse gas|greenhouse gases]] during mining operations.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Blažek|first=Vojtěch|title=Chtěl bych mluvit s Jiřikovským, říká ministerský poradce k bitcoinům|trans-title=I would like to speak with Jiřikovský, says ministerial advisor on Bitcoins |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-nevim-proc-blazek-s-bitcoiny-tak-spechal-rika-poradce-decroix-281367 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-07-09 |access-date=2025-07-09 |language=cs}}</ref> Despite his personal lack of expertise, Uhlíř initially intended to complete a report on the case by mid-August 2025. His objective was to analyze the acceptance of the donation and identify errors to be avoided in the future.<ref>{{Cite AV media |last=Drtinová|first=Daniela|work=DVTV |title= Bitcoinová kauza: Jiřikovského peněženky přezkoumávat nebudu, říká koordinátor vyšetřování |trans-title=Bitcoin Case: I will not examine Jiřikovský's wallets, says investigation coordinator |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w_w0M5NNbRc |date=9 July 2025|language=cs|via=[[YouTube]]|publisher=Online Partners}}</ref> However, after one month, he abruptly resigned, stating that he would not provide the report at all, though he claimed to have fulfilled the task assigned by Decroix.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Pokorná |first=Zdislava |title=Měl pro Decroix prověřit bitcoinovou kauzu, po měsíci náhle skončil|trans-title=He was supposed to investigate the Bitcoin case for Decroix; he quit suddenly after a month |url=https://denikn.cz/1796107/mel-pro-decroix-proverit-bitcoinovou-kauzu-po-mesici-nahle-skoncil/ |work=Deník N |date=2025-07-28 |language=cs|publisher=N Media}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Müller |first=Matyáš |title=Koordinátor objasňování bitcoinové kauzy po měsíci skončil, zprávu neodevzdá|trans-title=Uhlíř, coordinator for clarifying the Bitcoin case, has resigned |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/koordinator-objasnovani-bitcoinove-kauzy-po-mesici-necekane-skoncil.A250728_122247_domaci_ijan |work=iDNES.cz |publisher=Mafra |date=2025-07-28 |access-date=2025-07-28 |language=cs}}</ref> For his services, Uhlíř received a payment of 160,000 CZK excluding VAT.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Kuželová|first=Marie|title=Koordinátor k bitcoinové kauze skončil. Zpráva nebude|trans-title=Coordinator for the Bitcoin case has finished. No report will be issued |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-koordinator-k-bitcoinove-kauze-skoncil-40532045 |work=Novinky.cz |date=2025-07-28 |access-date=2025-07-28 |language=cs|publisher=Borgis}}</ref>

{{Quote frame |quote=I’m not sure whether I was merely used or outright exploited, but they undoubtedly wanted someone other than a complete nobody for the task. |author=David Uhlíř|source=about his role as coordinator in November 2025<ref>{{cite news |last=Paseková |first=Eva |title=„Nevím, jestli mě využili nebo zneužili,“ říká Uhlíř k vyšetřování bitcoinové kauzy |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2025/10/nevim-jestli-me-vyuzili-nebo-zneuzili-rika-uhlir-k-vysetrovani-bitcoinove-kauzy/ |access-date=14 March 2026 |work=Česká justice |publisher=Media Network |date=9 November 2025|language=cs}}</ref>}}

The failure to produce a final report and Uhlíř's overall role in the investigation were met with incomprehension from Czech President [[Petr Pavel]] and representatives of the [[Mayors and Independents|STAN]] movement.<ref>{{Cite news |agency=Czech News Agency|title=Pavel nerozumí, proč skončil bitcoinový koordinátor. STAN žádá dopracování jeho zprávy |trans-title=Pavel does not understand why the Bitcoin coordinator ended. It is not intelligible, he said in a critique of the government |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/pavel-nerozumi-proc-skoncil-bitcoinovy-koordinator-neni-to-srozumitelne-rekl.A250730_093231_domaci_hejj |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-07-30 |access-date=2025-07-30 |language=cs|publisher=Mafra}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title= ‚Zveřejněte zprávu k bitcoinové kauze.‘ Vedení STAN vyzývá ministerstvo spravedlnosti k transparentnosti|trans-title='Publish the Bitcoin case report.' STAN leadership calls on the Ministry of Justice for transparency |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/zverejnete-zpravu-k-bitcoinove-kauze-vedeni-stan-vyzyva-ministerstvo_2507301121_adm |work=iROZHLAS.cz |date=2025-07-30 |access-date=2025-07-30 |language=cs|publisher=[[Czech Radio]]|agency=[[Czech News Agency]]}}</ref> Decroix responded to the criticism by stating that Uhlíř would draft a report regarding the Ministry's internal processes during the case following his vacation. During a press conference, Decroix likened Uhlíř's continued involvement to: "a theatrical engagement that would again be uneconomical."<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hovorková |first=Eliška |title=Uhlíř je připraven sepsat zprávu k bitcoinové kauze, řekla Decroix|trans-title=Former coordinator Uhlíř is ready to write a report on the Bitcoin case, Decroix said |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/decroix-ministerstvo-bitcoiny-uhlir-koordinator.A250730_141429_domaci_hejj |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-07-30 |access-date=2025-07-30 |language=cs|publisher=Mafra}}</ref> Upon returning from vacation, however, Uhlíř refused to write the report, asserting that since his professional relationship with the Ministry had ended, he had no reason to work on it.<ref>{{Cite news |agency=Czech News Agency |title=Stát neměl bitcoiny přijímat, uvedl Uhlíř. Zprávu o kauze psát nehodlá|trans-title=Uhlíř will not produce the Bitcoin report. I no longer have a reason to do so, he said |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/bitcoin-kauza-uhlir-nevypracuje-zpravu-nema-po-skonceni-duvod.A250805_133904_domaci_ikul |work=iDNES.cz |date=2025-08-05 |access-date=2025-08-05 |language=cs|publisher=Mafra}}</ref> He further remarked that the Ministry should never have accepted the donation in the first place, stating: "He who receives a gift is not free."<ref>{{Cite news |last=Beneda |first=Josef|title= ‚Kdo je obdarován, není svobodný.‘ Ministerstvo nemělo podle Uhlíře přijímat bitcoinový dar |trans-title='He who receives a gift is not free.' According to Uhlíř, the Ministry should not have accepted the Bitcoin donation |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/kdo-je-obdarovan-neni-svobodny-ministerstvo-nemelo-podle-uhlire-prijimat_2508051701_job |work=iROZHLAS.cz |date=2025-08-05 |access-date=2025-08-05 |language=cs|publisher=Czech Radio}}</ref> According to a published timesheet, Uhlíř spent six hours studying the case timeline and another 25 hours on related duties, totaling 60 hours of work for the Ministry of Justice.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Úrad Decroix zveřejnil Uhlířův výkaz práce. „Odvádění pozornosti,“ reagoval|trans-title=Decroix's office published Uhlíř's timesheet. "A distraction," he reacted |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-urad-decroix-zverejnil-uhliruv-vykaz-prace-odvadeni-pozornosti-reagoval-283534 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=2025-08-09 |access-date=2025-08-10 |language=cs}}</ref> Decroix herself later noted that the role of the "BTC Case Coordinator" had no actual impact on the steps taken by the Ministry during the investigation.<ref name=":29">{{Cite news |last1=Vaculík|first1=Radim|last2=Svorník|first2=Petr|title=Decroix: Blažkovy výroky jsou atomové bomby|trans-title=Decroix: Blažek's statements are atomic bombs |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-decroix-blazkovy-vyroky-jsou-atomove-bomby-40535381 |work=Novinky.cz |date=2025-08-23 |access-date=2025-08-23 |language=cs|publisher=Borgis}}</ref>

== Discrepancies regarding access to case documents in the Senate ==
Chief Public Prosecutor {{ill|Radim Dragoun|cs}} stated that, as of July 22, 2025, no formal charges had been brought in the case.<ref>{{cite news |title=Vrchní státní zástupce: V bitcoinové kauze není nikdo trestně stíhán |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-vrchni-statni-zastupce-v-bitcoinove-kauze-neni-nikdo-trestne-stihan-282354 |access-date=15 March 2026 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=22 July  2025|language=cs}}</ref> On the same day, Minister Eva Decroix reiterated that the state had incurred no [[Damages|damages]] from the acceptance of the donation.<ref>{{cite news |title=Státu kvůli bitcoinové kauze nevznikla žádná škoda, tvrdí Decroix |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/bitcoinova-kauza-minstryne-spravedlnosti-eva-decroix-stat-skoda.A250722_130117_domaci_lupr |access-date=15 March 2026 |work=iDNES.cz |publisher=Mafra |date=22 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref> In an interview with ''[[Reflex (magazine)|Reflex]]'', Decroix characterized those highlighting a conflict of interest due to her membership in the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) as purveyors of [[disinformation]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Prchalová |first=Barbora |title=Ministryně spravedlnosti Decroix: Bitcoinová kauza nešla politicky ustát, teď je v rukou policie |url=https://www.reflex.cz/clanek/rozhovory/131299/ministryne-spravedlnosti-decroix-bitcoinova-kauza-nesla-politicky-ustat-ted-je-v-rukou-policie.html |access-date=15 March 2026 |work=Reflex |publisher=Czech New Center |date=24 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref>

In response to efforts aimed at restricting the dissemination of investigative details to prevent potential interference, Decroix filed a motion for supervisory review with {{ill|Supreme Public Prosecutor|cs|Nejvyšší státní zastupitelství}} [[Lenka Bradáčová]]. The objective of this oversight was to ensure that the criminal proceedings were not subject to undue delays and that the principles [[Governance|governing]] the conduct of law enforcement authorities were strictly upheld.<ref>{{cite news |agency=Czech News Agency |title=Bitcoinová kauza: Decroix chce dohled Bradáčové nad vyšetřováním |url=https://www.forum24.cz/bitcoinova-kauza-decroix-chce-dohled-bradacove-nad-vysetrovanim |access-date=16 March 2026 |work=Forum 24 |publisher=FORUM 24 |date=28 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Bradáčová má zasáhnout do bitcoinové kauzy. Decroix si stěžuje na mlčení žalobců |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2025/07/bradacova-ma-zasahnout-do-bitcoinove-kauzy/ |access-date=16 March 2026 |work=Česká justice |publisher=Media Network |date=28 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref> Dragoun reacted negatively to the Minister's assertions, maintaining that the staff of the Olomouc Public Prosecutor's Office had consistently responded promptly and to an extent appropriate for the current stage of the criminal proceedings.<ref>{{cite news |title=V bitcoinové kauze jsme odpověděli obratem, brání se žalobce výtkám Decroix |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/dragoun-decroix-bitcoinova-kauza.A250729_110600_domaci_hejj |access-date=16 March 2026 |work=iDNES.cz |publisher=Mafra |date=29 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref> One day after Decroix requested assistance, the Supreme Public Prosecutor initiated the supervisory review.<ref>{{cite news |last=Paseková |first=Eva |title=Bradáčová spouští dohled v bitcoinové kauze. Kritiku ministryně ale Dragoun odmítá |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2025/07/bradacova-spousti-dohled-v-bitcoinove-kauze/ |access-date=16 March 2026 |work=Česká justice |publisher=Media Network |date=29 July 2025|language=cs}}</ref>

On the same day Dragoun confirmed the absence of [[Indictment|indictments]], the Senate Committee on Foreign Affairs, Defense, and Security met with Decroix to discuss the progression of the case. The session was conducted in a confidential (classified) format. During the meeting, senators discovered they were not entitled to certain segments of information. The Vice-Chairman of the committee, [[Robert Šlachta]], criticized the proceedings, stating:

{{Quote frame |quote=The meeting was entirely futile. [...] I was not demanding information from the criminal proceedings. [...] I am not one to see ghosts where there are none, but who specifically selected these auditing firms? Why does Dr. Uhlíř have access to all information while senators do not? [...] By whom was Dr. Uhlíř nominated?}}

Prior to the committee's initial session, Decroix had already withheld all written communication pertaining to the case and failed to answer five specific [[Question|questions]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ciroková |first1=Kristina |last2=Blažek |first2=Vojtěch |title=Senátoři jsou naštvaní na Decroix. Tají jim dokumenty k bitcoinové kauze |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-senatori-jsou-nastvani-na-decroix-taji-jim-dokumenty-k-bitcoinove-kauze-279657 |access-date=18 March 2026 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=20 June 2025|language=cs}}</ref> The meeting concluded with the Senate expressing a conditional belief in the integrity of the Ministry's internal investigation. The day after the committee session, Uhlíř terminated his cooperation with the Ministry of Justice and departed for [[vacation]] abroad. The next committee hearing was scheduled for August 26, 2025.<ref>{{cite news |title=Bitcoinová kauza pod drobnohledem Senátu: Výbor se sejde 26. srpna |url=https://ekonomickydenik.cz/bitcoinova-kauza-pod-drobnohledem-senatu-vybor-se-sejde-26-srpna/ |access-date=18 March 2026 |work=Ekonomický deník |publisher=Media Network |date=11 August 2025|language=cs}}</ref>

== Coordinator's absence from Senate proceedings ==
During the second hearing of the Senate committee, senators requested a comprehensive timeline detailing the development of the Bitcoin case prior to the assets being donated to the state. In response, Eva Decroix directed the committee to the InfoSoud [[database]]. The committee did not establish binding deadline for the submission of this summary.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gričová |first1=Andrea |last2=Šulcová |first2=Johana |agency=[[Czech News Agency]] |title=Senátní výbor chce po Decroix vývoj kauzy bitcoinů před darováním. Resort odkázal na databázi |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/senatni-vybor-chce-po-decroix-vyvoj-kauzy-bitcoinu-pred-darovanim-statu-364395 |access-date=18 March 2026 |work=[[ČT24]] |publisher=[[Czech Television]] |date=26 August 2025|language=cs}}</ref>
Although David Uhlíř and Lenka Bradáčová were originally invited to the second session, Uhlíř ultimately did not attend. Committee member [[Jana Mračková Vildumetzová]] informed the session that Uhlíř had traveled abroad, though he expressed his willingness to participate later, stating, "I would be happy to attend in September."<ref>{{cite news |title=Bývalý koordinátor Uhlíř se nezúčastní v Senátu jednání o bitcoinové kauze |url=https://denikn.cz/minuta/1818640/ |access-date=18 March 2026 |work=Minuta N |publisher=N Media |date=25 August 2025|language=cs}}</ref>

The High Public Prosecutor, Lenka Bradáčová, briefed the senators on the scope, [[methodology]], and [[Legal doctrine|legal framework]] of the prosecutorial oversight. However, she noted that her mandate to testify before the committee was constrained by statutory confidentiality [[Obligation|obligations]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ciroková |first1=Kristina |last2=Blažek |first2=Vojtěch |title=Senátoři jsou naštvaní na Decroix. Tají jim dokumenty k bitcoinové kauze |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-senatori-jsou-nastvani-na-decroix-taji-jim-dokumenty-k-bitcoinove-kauze-279657 |access-date=18 March 2026 |work=[[Seznam Zprávy]] |date=20 June 2025|language=cs}}</ref> Regarding the disclosure of evidence, Bradáčová remarked, "It is always at the discretion of the Minister of Justice which documents are presented to the committee."<ref>{{cite news |agency=Czech News Agency |last=Kaprál |first=Adam |title=Balík se Šlachtou hovořili o bitcoinové kauze i korespondenční volbě |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/balik-se-slachtou-hovorili-o-bitcoinove-kauze-a-korespondencni-volbe-364422 |access-date=19 March 2026 |work=ČT24 |publisher=Czech Television |date=26 August 2025}}</ref>

== Scope of legal violations expanded ==
Members of the National Center Against Organized Crime (NCOZ) conducted a raid during the night of 14–15 August 2025. Several individuals, including Jiřikovský, were detained, and items pertinent to the criminal proceedings were seized.<ref name=":25a">{{cite web|last1=Jaňurek|first1=Pavel|last2=Burian|first2=Václav|last3=Kozelka|first3=Petr| title = Dramatická razie kvůli bitcoinové kauze. Jiřikovský před policisty utekl na střechu| trans-title =Police launch massive overnight raid in Bitcoin case; Jiřikovský detained| website = Novinky.cz| url = https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/krimi-policie-zasahuje-kvuli-bitcoinove-kauze-zajistuje-veci-40534285| date = 2025-08-15| language = cs| access-date = 2025-08-15|publisher=Borgis}}</ref> High Prosecuting Attorney Radim Dragoun stated that the operation pertained to suspicions of laundering proceeds of [[Crime|criminal activity]] and the illicit handling of [[Psychoactive drug|narcotics]]. Commenting on the complexity of the case, Dragoun remarked: ''"This is a criminal matter that was recently severed by the police authority from joint proceedings into a separate case, as the original scope of the investigation is broader."'' <ref name=":26a">{{cite web| title =Zátah v kauze bitcoin. Policie zadržela a obvinila Jiřikovského| trans-title = Police raid in Bitcoin case: Focus on Jiřikovský, narcotics, and money laundering| website = Seznam Zprávy| url = https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-politika-policie-zasahuje-v-bitcoinove-kauze-zajistuje-osoby-a-veci-283877| date = 2025-08-14| language = cs| access-date = 2025-08-15|agency=Czech News Agency}}</ref>

== Professional consequences of the investigation ==
The scope of the case is underscored by professional repercussions affecting both direct and indirect participants. In September 2025, the [[Czech Bar Association]] investigated Blažek over suspected violations of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Act. The Association received the initial complaint in June 2025, followed by a second in August 2025; the complainants alleged that Blažek had breached professional and ethical boundaries. Blažek declined to provide media commentary regarding the grievances filed with the chamber.<ref>{{cite news |last=Horák |first=Jan |title=Advokátní komora prověřuje exministra Blažka pro podezření z porušení zákona proti praní špinavých peněz |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/advokatni-komora-proveruje-exministra-blazka-kvuli-podezreni-z-poruseni-zakona-o_2509100904_hrk |access-date=26 March 2026 |work=iROZHLAS |publisher=Czech Radio |date=10 September 2025|language=cs}}</ref> In March 2026, the Chamber announced that it had declined to file any complaints against Blažek.<ref>{{cite news |title=Blažek nebude čelit kárné žalobě advokátní komory. Stížnost kvůli bitcoinové kauze je podle ní nedůvodná |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/blazek-nebude-celit-karne-zalobe-advokatni-komory-stiznost-kvuli-bitcoinove_2603021242_ako |access-date=26 March 2026 |work=iROZHLAS |agency=Czech News Agency |publisher=Czech Radio |date=2 March 2026|language=cs}}</ref>

Beyond Blažek, the case also impacted the career of Brno public prosecutor Marek Vagai, who represented the state in the 2017 legal proceedings against Jiřikovský. In November 2025, Vagai's superiors considered filing a disciplinary motion, alleging that he failed to sufficiently contest the restitution of seized electronics to the programmer.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Blažek |first1=Vojtěch |last2=Ciroková |first2=Kristina |title=Nadřízení chtějí potrestat žalobce z bitcoinové kauzy |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-nadrizeni-chteji-potrestat-zalobce-z-bitcoinove-kauzy-291934 |access-date=26 March 2026 |work=Seznam Zprávy |date=21 November 2025|language=cs}}</ref>

== Developments at the Ministry of Justice following the 2025 general election ==
Following the 2025 general election, [[Jeroným Tejc]] (ANO), successor to Decroix, stated that while he would prefer to distance himself from the case entirely, he considered it necessary to restructure the Ministry’s legal department to ensure its [[Ratione materiae|immunity]] to political pressure.<ref>{{cite news |last=Paseková |first=Eva |title=Po bitcoinové kauze chce Tejc přestavět ministerstvo. Připouští i propouštění |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2025/12/po-bitcoinove-kauze-chce-tejc-prestavet-ministerstvo/ |access-date=29 March 2026 |work=Česká justice |publisher=Media Network |date=18 December 2025|language=cs}}</ref> Tejc emphasized that, beyond implementing technical safeguards to prevent a recurrence of the incident, he must address the event itself.<ref>{{cite AV media |last1=Pancíř |first1=Tomáš |last2=Odložilová |first2=Pavlína |title=Bitcoinovou kauzou se zabývat nechci, ale musím. Je třeba zabránit opakování chyb, říká Tejc |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NgrmvWN9Ic |access-date=29 March 2026 |work=[[ČRo Radiožurnál]] |publisher=Czech Radio |date=19 December 2025|via=YouTube|language=cs}}</ref>

In December 2025, Tejc reviewed the risks associated with potential litigation against Ministry of Justice. He noted the possibility of not finalizing all contracts with the original cryptocurrency purchasers. By January 2026, Tejc moved to insulate all legal staff responsible for adjudicating further donations to the Ministry from the direct jurisdiction of the Minister, thereby ensuring greater institutional [[independence]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Stát zaplatil za kauzu bitcoin desítky milionů, přínos není zatím žádný, uvedl ministr Tejc |url=https://www.echo24.cz/a/HF3vh/ministr-spravedlnosti-tejc-blazek-bitcoin-kauza-naklady-audit-snemovna-duvera-vlada-domaci-vezeni-drogy |access-date=29 March 2026 |work=Echo24 |publisher=Echo Media |date=13 January 2026|language=cs}}</ref>

== Dissolution of the first Olomouc investigative team ==
In January 2026, prosecutor Petra Lastovecká proposed indicting Pavel Blažek for the acceptance of a bribe during a meeting of the High Public Prosecutor's Office in Olomouc.<ref>{{cite news |last=Skalický |first=Matěj |title=„Dějí se v tom podivné věci.“ Reportérka o změnách v šetření kauzy bitcoin i zlomové lednové schůzce |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/deji-se-v-tom-podivne-veci-reporterka-o-zmenach-v-setreni-kauzy-bitcoin-i_2603050600_med |access-date=2 April 2026 |work=iROZHLAS |publisher=Czech Radio |date=5 March 2026|language=cs}}</ref> At that time, sufficient evidence reportedly existed to also charge his deputy, Radomír Daňhel.<ref>{{cite news |last=Pokorná |first=Zdislava |title=Žalobci chtěli obvinit Blažka v kauze Bitcoin. A začaly se dít „bezprecedentní“ věci |url=https://denikn.cz/1985655/zalobci-chteli-obvinit-blazka-v-kauze-bitcoin-a-zacaly-se-dit-bezprecedentni-veci/ |access-date=2 April 2026 |work=Deník N |publisher=N Media |date=25 February 2026|language=cs}}</ref> Although Radim Dragoun, who attended the meeting, did not initially contest Lastovecká's plan, a series of irregular developments regarding the composition of the investigative team followed the session’s conclusion.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-26 |title=V bitcoinové kauze padl návrh obvinit exministra Blažka, nakonec nastaly změny |url=https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/kauza-bitcoin-ministerstvo-spravedlnosti-pavel-blazek-zalobci.A260226_102922_domaci_vank |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=iDNES.cz}}</ref>

Following the meeting, Dragoun instructed his subordinate, Petr Šereda, to review Lastovecká’s involvement in the team on the grounds of potential bias. Dragoun claimed this move was based on a recommendation from High Public Prosecutor Lenka Bradáčová. However, Bradáčová subsequently stated the contrary, asserting that her recommendation had actually been to maintain the team's original composition. Šereda, who found the instruction highly unusual given the investigation's new phase, subsequently resigned. He was succeeded by Radek Bartoš, who proceeded to dissolve the existing team; Lastovecká was not included in the newly formed investigative group.

In late March 2026, a press conference was held to address the team's dissolution, attended by Lenka Bradáčová, Zdeněk Kasal, Radim Dragoun, and Lucie Slámová. Bradáčová criticized the opaque communication from the Olomouc prosecutors and noted that her supervisory capacity was limited, while also confirming leaks from the case file.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-16 |title=Není nestranná, řekl vrchní žalobce. Vyloučil kolegyni z bitcoinové kauzy - Seznam Zprávy |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-kauzy-bradacova-a-dalsi-spicky-zalobcu-mimoradne-komentuji-bitcoinovou-kauzu-301694 |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.seznamzpravy.cz |language=cs}}</ref>

These limitations arose because Bradáčová had provided testimony to the Police of the Czech Republic regarding a contract signed between the Ministry of Justice and Jiřikovský on July 31, 2025. Consequently, procedural authority shifted to Zdeněk Kasal, who formally approved Dragoun's decision to remove Lastovecká. Dragoun later denied that a formal "first investigative team" had ever existed, claiming Lastovecká had only been tasked with partial assignments.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-03-16 |title=Ministr spravedlnosti Jeroným Tejc (nestr. za ANO) Deníku N napsal, že se i nadále bude zabývat postupem žalobců okolo bitcoinové kauzy |url=https://denikn.cz/minuta/2004297/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Deník N |language=cs}}</ref>

While Dragoun dismissed reporting by Deník N as factually incorrect in its entirety, journalists from the outlet pointed out that the events detailed in their coverage were effectively confirmed during the press conference. Lucie Slámová confirmed the security breach and stated she had referred the matter to [[General Inspection of Security Forces]] (GIBS).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pospíchal |first=Tobiáš |date=2026-03-16 |title=Neodpovídá to skutečnosti, řekli žalobci o článcích Deníku N. Pak události v kauze bitcoin potvrdili |url=https://denikn.cz/2003963/neodpovida-to-skutecnosti-rekli-zalobci-o-clancich-deniku-n-pak-udalosti-v-kauze-bitcoin-potvrdili/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Deník N |language=cs}}</ref> The leak from the file was also confirmed by the then-Minister of Justice, Jeroným Tejc.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-03-18 |title=Náš audit k bitcoinové kauze přinese nová zjištění, řekl ministr Tejc |url=https://www.denik.cz/cesko/nas-audit-k-bitcoinove-kauze-prinese-nova-zjisteni-rekl-ministr-jeronym-tejc/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |work=www.denik.cz |language=cs}}</ref>

== Tejc's reaction to the dissclusion of the Olomouc team ==
Then-Minister of Justice Jeroným Tejc characterized the dissclusion of the Olomouc investigative team and the subsequent personnel as peculiar.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Pokorná |first=Zdislava |date=2026-03-02 |title=„Velmi zvláštní.“ Ministra spravedlnosti znepokojil vývoj kolem bitcoinové kauzy |url=https://denikn.cz/1990183/velmi-zvlastni-ministra-spravedlnosti-znepokojil-vyvoj-kolem-bitcoinove-kauzy/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Deník N |language=cs}}</ref> According to Tejc, the case had been handled by seasoned prosecutors. The minister heavily criticized both the timing of the branch transfer of the case, which occurred immediately prior to the formal indictment of the individuals involved, and the procedural burdens associated with the handoff.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Křovák |first=Jan |date=2026-03-02 |title=Tejc chce kvůli bitcoinové kauze zavést kontrolu státních zástupců „po vzoru GIBS“ - Echo24.cz |url=https://www.echo24.cz/a/H5Sxk/zpravy-domaci-tejc-chce-kvuli-kauze-bitcoin-inspekci-pro-kontrolu-statnich-zastupcu |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.echo24.cz |language=cs}}</ref>

Beyond verbal commentary, Tejc responded poltically by proposing the establishment of an oversight body tasked with investigating suspected criminal offenses comitted by [[Prosecutor|prosecutors]], including [[Data breach|data leaks]] from case files and manipulation of investigative team assignments. This newly conceived institution is intended to be modeled after General Inspection of Security Forces.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Networks |first=Media |last2=ČTK |date=2026-03-02 |title=Bitcoinová kauza: Tejc chce novou inspekci, žalobci nemají vyšetřovat sami sebe |url=https://www.ceska-justice.cz/2026/03/bitcoinova-kauza-tejc-chce-novou-inspekci-zalobci-nemaji-vysetrovat-sami-sebe/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Česká justice |language=cs}}</ref>

== Changes of lead investigators in the case ==
During the investigation of the case, the lead investigator was replaced twice as of March 2026. The first lead investigator of the case ended up facing a [[criminal complaint]] over suspicion of committing a criminal offense. The second lead prosecutor in order ended up being dismissed for influencing witnesses after making the following statement to Jiřikovský's mother and brother:
{{Quote|text=It is certainly not [Titz] who defends the brother's interests, but he defends Mr. Blažek's interests. The brother is not in this alone, but it would be a pity if the others slipped away. The brother was not able to arrange this alone, but other people are behind it.|sign=the second lead investigator on the stairs to Jiřikovský's mother and brother<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kozelka |first1=Petr |title=Vyšetřovatel bitcionové kauzy z NCOZ má na krku trestní oznámení, další měl ovlivňovat svědky |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/krimi-vysetrovatel-bitcionove-kauzy-z-ncoz-ma-na-krku-trestni-oznameni-dalsi-mel-ovlivnovat-svedky-40569439 |access-date=27 August 2026 |work=Novinky.cz |publisher=Borgis |date=26 March 2026}}</ref>}}
Defense attorneys were not satisfied with the third lead investigator either. Jiřikovský's defense lawyers have long criticized the fact that police officers tried to persuade the programmer to cooperate through various informal offers.
